title: spiranthes simplex var. neuroptera
intro: Spiranthes simplex var. neuroptera, commonly known as the Northern Ladies' Tresses, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in North America, for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The Northern Ladies' Tresses is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
